reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 12 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; verified separated upper/lower cap badges, two-bar collar tabs, two note rows, absence of facial hair, portrait/collar/backing and the original right-edge tab.

remaining_reasons: The source's small dark right-edge note tab is not retained. The returned native right edge instead has a triangular paper fold/notch and no compact dark tab in the original position/form. Restore the original small dark tab and edge construction; do not substitute a crease, torn notch or new hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The prior cap-insignia problem is corrected: a separate small upper emblem and lower circular badge sit above the silver braided band, rather than one merged winged leaf cluster. Covered hair, dark brows, no glasses, no moustache or beard and one serious closed mouth remain. The near-frontal upright pose, direct gaze, crop and strong under-cap shadow are retained. The dark charcoal high-collared uniform keeps one pale two-bar tab on each visible collar side, with a short broad fitted neck and no stalk or pinching. The complete dark frame and opaque dark green-grey/charcoal backplate remain. The cream note has TWO upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the right-edge tab substitution remains a separate visible rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Internal ornament of the tiny cap badges, collar details and note lettering are unreadable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The separated badge arrangement and two note rows are visible, while the missing dark tab versus replacement fold is clearly resolved in the native return and enlarged source.
